## What landed (two commits)

- `hh-env::egress_allowlist` — transactional `admit_allowlist_mediated` (byte-identical refusal): `net.mode=mediated`, `--network none` stance, closed `{model,egress}` socket grants + mounts, permanent deny rules (hub.harborframework.com, tbench.ai, declared mirrors), sealed `phase_schedule` (setup→agent→verify `policy_rule` layers, `principal` authority; verify closes the model socket), 6 declared residuals (unix_socket ×2, tls_opaque, approved_host_body, dns_names, side_channel), env routing hints (`no_proxy` mandatory, `validate_cell_env` refuses token-named members), record stamps + `allowlist{protocol_id,epoch,digest}` + result label. `Allowlist` (Q-X55 first pass: agent=apt∪PyPI∪npm∪crates, no github.com; verify=agent∪scan∪oracle hosts), `WithheldHost`, `AllowlistFreeze` (`hh-egress-allowlist-freeze/1`; changed digest under same protocol+epoch → `allowlist_changed`), `allowlist_gap` basis `runner_infeasible:allowlist_gap{host}`, `scan_hosts_in_text`, `MediatedCell`, `cell_record_section`.
- `hh-cell-relay` — std-only bin in `hh-helper`: `--pair <model|egress>=<port>=<sock>` binds loopback ⇄ unix socket; cell's main process under `--init` (PID-1 signal reaches it via catatonit); musl target admitted in `rust-toolchain.toml`.
- `podman.rs`/`hh_helper.rs` — `SocketMount`/`RelaySpec`: `-v host:/run/hh/<name>.sock` + `-v bin:/hh/bin/hh-cell-relay:ro` mounts, relay tail replaces `sleep infinity`; closed-name flags.
- `driver.rs`/`handle.rs` — `mediated_cell` handle field → helper argv; `per_phase_network_policy=supported` read off the admitted record.
- `egress.rs` — `pre_wire` extraction (resolve→recheck→guards→sentinels→budget→`decided{allow}` durable) shared by `forward` and new `forward_tunnel`; `EgressTransport::dial` + `ByteStream`; `MediatedOutcome::Tunneled`; tunnel closed row + network.calls charge.
- `hh-egress-mediator` bin — sole store writer; per-connection policy reload (phase swap = file write); CONNECT→`forward_tunnel` + 200, HTTP→`forward`; mints slot effect token internally (never in-cell).
- `classes.rs` — `security.egress.tunnel.closed` registered (+HOSTED_LOWERING passthrough).
- `slot_record.rs` — `identity.infrastructure` member (strict; `{runner,helper,relay,model_proxy,egress_mediator}.binary_sha256`) — relay digest in identity (REQ-XC-330 shape; full set R6.23).
